data.name: Alcyone
data.gender_notes: Alcyone is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Alcyone was the name of a woman who was turned into a kingfisher by the gods. The name Alcyone carries the meaning “Kingfisher” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Alcyone usually hope their child will grow to embody kingfisher and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Alcyone belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Kingfisher.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alcyone total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלציון הוא שם שמקורו במילה היוונית אלκυόνη, שפירושו 'נוחתים' או 'יורדים'. השם קשור למילה העברית 'אלץ', שפירושו 'לרדת' או 'להנחות'. השם אלציון מוזכר בתרבות היהודית ככינוי לאחת הנשים המוזכרות בספרות היהודית.

in_greek.name: Αλκυόνη
in_greek.long_meaning: Αλκυόνη είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική λέξη 'αλκυόνη', που σημαίνει 'κατερχόμενοι' ή 'πλέουσες'. Το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με την ελληνική μυθολογία και την παράδοση της Εκκλησίας. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Αλκυόνη δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα, αλλά η ετυμολογία του συνδέεται με την πλοήγη και την καθοδήγηση.

in_latin.name: Alcyone
in_latin.long_meaning: Alcyone is derived from the Greek word 'alkyōnē', meaning 'descending' or 'sailing'. This name has been used in Christian tradition to signify guidance and providence. The Latin Church adopted various Greek names, and Alcyone has been used in the context of Christian nomenclature to reflect heavenly guidance.

in_english.name: Alcyone
in_english.long_meaning: Alcyone originates from the Greek word 'alkyōnē', meaning 'descending' or 'sailing'. In Christian tradition, Alcyone symbolizes spiritual guidance and providence. Historically, the name has been associated with heavenly navigation and protection. Today, Alcyone remains a meaningful name in Christian cultures, reflecting virtues of leadership and divine guidance.

data.cultural_impact: Alcyone holds a rich cultural history as a name that originated from Greek mythology. In this myth, Alcyone was a woman known for her great love for her husband, Ceyx. Their love was so strong that when Ceyx died at sea, Alcyone threw herself into the sea in grief, and the gods took pity on her by transforming both of them into kingfishers, allowing them to spend eternity together in the sky. Thus, the name Alcyone often symbolizes enduring love and transformed devotion.
data.spiritual_significance: In a more spiritual sense, the Alcyone name carries the message of transformation, hope, and the eternal nature of love. As a Christian, Alcyone could be seen as a reminder of God's love that is constant and unchanging. The myth of Alcyone and Ceyx also serves as a powerful reminder of the transformative power of faith, as even in the face of great loss and despair, they were granted the gift of eternal life and love. Additionally, the Alcyone name could be interpreted as a call to keep faith in the face of adversity and to trust that God's love and grace will see us through even the darkest of times.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Alcyone represents the eternal love and devotion between the Christian soul and Christ. It symbolizes the unwavering commitment to remain steadfast in faith even amidst life's storms, just like the mythological Alcyone who was transformed into a kingfisher that never perished in the stormy sea.

historical_references.reference: Alcyone is mentioned in the works of the poet Alcman (7th century BC) and the historian Herodotus (5th century BC)
historical_references.context: In ancient Greek mythology, Alcyone was a sea-nymph and the mother of the Halcyon birds

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Alcyone remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named Hannah Alcyone in Athens, Greece credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Alcyone, which means "Kingfisher". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
